verdict.rationale: GlitchTip explicitly offers a data residency option (a fully independent EU instance hosted in Frankfurt) plus self-hosting via Docker, which lets users control where data lives; a BAA is also available for compliance needs. However, evidence does not show a broader multi-region choice (e.g., US/EU/APAC selection at signup) beyond the single EU instance and self-hosting. Missing for 10: documented region selection UI/API, list of supported regions beyond EU, and independent confirmation of residency guarantees.
